messages:
Mike (AE): Quick sync 026-02-12 0: AcmeHealth POC looks healthy, legal returned redlines on MSA/DPA. Need pricing confirmation and signature path. Can legal + procurement weigh in?
Sara (Sales Ops): Pinged @Julia @Amelia. Order form attached below (snippet). Customer expects Dedicated pool + 100k tokens/month, start 2026-04-01.
Tom (SE): Verified their sample prompts 026-02-11	: 95th pct latency within SLA on dedicated config. No infra changes required.
Mike (AE): Buyer asked if we can lock a committed rate for first 6 months with a 20% discount. Also asking whether they'd sign via PO + e-sign or direct DocuSign only.
Amelia (Procurement): Acme prefers PO generation after DocuSign. Finance requires invoice generated once PO is received. They can do Net30. Need billing address and tax ID to include on envelope.
Julia (Legal): Redlines summary: (1) liability cap increase from $1M to $5M; (2) EU data residency carveout for EU tenants; (3) DPA: full subprocessor list and 30-day notice for additions.
Mike (AE): Is $5M an absolute deal blocker if they request it?
Julia (Legal): Standard for Dedicated=enterprise contract. We could approve up to $3M with exec signoff. $5M requires review with insurance and CRO. What's expected ARR?
Mike (AE): Committed spend ~ $12k/month, so ~ $144k/year. Good chance to expand.
Tom (SE): One technical ask: order form must explicitly state instance/pool size and p99 SLA target so ops can provision.
Sara (Sales Ops): Order form snippet for signature:
```
Product: Redwood Dedicated - 1x A100-equivalent pool
Term: 12 months (auto renew)
Committed Tokens: 100,000/month
Unit Price: $0.00012/token (20% promotional discount applies to first 6 months)
Onboarding credit: One-time $5,000 credit
Billing: Invoice upon PO receipt, Net30
```
Mike (AE): Legal, is the pricing/articulation here fine? Also confirm whether discount must be capped or limited.
Julia (Legal): Pricing is commercial; legal needs clear clause: "Promotional discount applies to the first 6 months only." Also want auto-renew opt-out notice period (30 days prior to renewal).
Amelia (Procurement): DocuSign routing preference: Mike -> Acme Procurement (procure@acmehealth.com) -> Acme Legal (legal@acmehealth.com). After signed, Acme issues PO referencing DocuSign envelope ID. Finance asks that DocuSign include billing address and tax ID.
Mike (AE): Sales Ops can create envelope?
Sara (Sales Ops): Yes, I will prep envelope today and attach order form + MSA redline. Routing as Amelia requested.
Julia (Legal): I will post a redline in ~24h. Quick negotiation point: we prefer 60 days notice for subprocessor additions; customer wants 30. Can procurement accept 45 as middle ground?
Amelia (Procurement): Company policy prefers 30, but they sometimes accept 45 with legal rationale. I'll check.
Tom (SE): Operationally 30 vs 60 doesn't change deployment, it's a compliance window. 45 is fine from eng.
Finance Bot: FYI: PO value > $100k/year triggers Finance pre-approval checklist and AR lead sign-off. Current projection ~$144k/year.
Mike (AE): I'll flag to CRO for >$100k approval if needed.
Sara (Sales Ops): Action items: Julia - redline (24h). Sara - draft DocuSign envelope (today). Amelia - confirm billing address + PO contact (EOD). Mike - confirm discount term with customer.
Julia (Legal): Draft redline preview: propose liability cap at $3M (instead of $5M), propose 45-day subprocessor notice, provide subprocessor list within 10 days of signing. Keep other clauses minimal.
Amelia (Procurement): Once redline accepted, we'll sign via DocuSign and issue PO. Please include separate PO lines: (1) Dedicated runtime; (2) Onboarding services.
Mike (AE): Thanks all. I'll update Acme with the $3M/45-day compromise and request PO intent. If they insist on $5M, escalating to execs. :thumbsup:
Sara (Sales Ops): Noted. I'll queue envelope and ping when ready.
